name: Okinawa Senseki Quasi-National Park
description: Quasi-national park preserving the battle sites of southern Okinawa — the Peace Memorial Park, the Himeyuri cave and the Mabuni cliffs — amid the island's green coast.
notes: Managed by Okinawa. The Peace Memorial and the southern battle sites are the park's core.
parking: Parking available at major visitor areas (fee varies)

ja.description: 沖縄本島南部の戦跡を保存する国定公園。平和記念公園、ひめゆり洞窟、摩文仁の断崖が、島の緑豊かな海岸に広がる。
ja.notes: 沖縄県が管理。平和記念公園と南部の戦跡が公園の中心。
